tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Checks live availability of Villa Nautilus 222 for the requested arrival and departure dates.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Calculates the current Lodgify price. Adults, children and infants are counted separately. All guests currently have the same price. Maximum 10 guests in total.

tools.name: list_extras
tools.description: Returns the current additional services and prices available for Villa Nautilus 222.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Creates the Lodgify checkout URL with separate adult, child and infant counts. Maximum 10 guests in total.
